hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: Southwestern Asia, between Turkey (to the west) and Azerbaijan; note - Armenia views itself as part of Europe; geopolitically, it can be classified as falling within Europe, the Middle East, or both || Armenian Highland with mountains; little forest land; fast flowing rivers; good soil in Aras River valley || landlocked in the Lesser Caucasus Mountains; Sevana Lich (Lake Sevan) is the largest lake in this mountain range || Resources: small deposits of gold, copper, molybdenum, zinc, bauxite || Exports: gold, diamonds, copper ore, broadcasting equipment, jewelry (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: Armenian Highland with mountains; little forest land; fast flowing rivers; good soil in Aras River valley || Southwestern Asia, between Turkey (to the west) and Azerbaijan; note - Armenia views itself as part of Europe; geopolitically, it can be classified as falling within Europe, the Middle East, or both

climate.excerpt: highland continental, hot summers, cold winters || occasionally severe earthquakes; droughts

economy.excerpt: upper-middle income, fast-growing Caucasus economy; stable fiscal and monetary regime but vulnerable to geopolitical shocks; economic and energy ties to Russia but seeking more EU and US trade; key copper and gold exporter; business-friendly and anti-corruption reforms; persistent unemployment; influx of migrants from Ukraine war easing || Exports: gold, diamonds, copper ore, broadcasting equipment, jewelry (2023) || Industries: brandy, mining, diamond processing, metal-cutting machine tools, forging and pressing machines, electric motors, knitted wear, hosiery, shoes, silk fabric, chemicals, trucks, instruments, microelectronics, jewelry, software, food processing
